facts.text: The hotel is on Regent Street, where St. James's, Mayfair and Soho converge.
facts.excerpt: Ideally situated where St. James’, Mayfair and Soho converge, this luxury hotel on Regent Street

facts.text: Over more than 160 years, Café Royal has welcomed guests from Oscar Wilde and Winston Churchill to Princess Diana and David Bowie.
facts.excerpt: For over 160 years, Café Royal has welcomed those who make a difference, from Oscar Wilde and Winston Churchill to Princess Diana and David Bowie.

facts.text: Hotel Café Royal was named Best Hotel in the UK in The Independent's inaugural Travel Awards 2026, voted by readers.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Café Royal has been named Best Hotel in the UK in The Independent’s inaugural Travel Awards, an accolade from one of Britain’s most respected newspapers, and one decided entirely by its readers.

facts.text: Cakes & Bubbles is a dessert and pastry venue by pastry chef Albert Adrià, with a wide selection of Champagne and sparkling wine.
facts.excerpt: Cakes & Bubbles by the ‘World’s Best Pastry Chef’, Albert Adrià, offers a parade of exceptional desserts and pastries alongside a wide selection of Champagne and sparkling wine.

facts.text: Chef Alex Dilling offers a modern take on traditional French gastronomic cuisine at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Critically acclaimed, Alex Dilling, brings fine dining to a new level with his modern take on traditional French gastronomic cuisine.

facts.text: Akasha, the hotel's spa, was voted London's Best Hotel Spa 2025 by Time Out.
facts.excerpt: Proudly voted London’s Best Hotel Spa 2025 by Time Out

facts.text: Akasha is a subterranean spa.
facts.excerpt: enjoy £75 credit to spend at Akasha, our subterranean spa

facts.text: All guests receive complimentary access to the gym, pool and wellness classes.
facts.excerpt: All guests receive complimentary access to our gym, pool, and wellness classes

facts.text: The hotel's event spaces include a Grade II-listed ballroom.
facts.excerpt: From refined meeting rooms to a Grade II-listed ballroom

facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed by Sir David Chipperfield.
facts.excerpt: Designed by Sir David Chipperfield, contemporary elements are beautifully woven with classic materials, such as fumed English Oak panelling

facts.text: Superior Rooms sit in the eaves of the hotel and look out over London's rooftops.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in the eaves of the hotel, our Superior Rooms look out to London’s rooftops.

facts.text: The Celestine Suite is named after Celestine Nichols, wife of Café Royal's founder.
facts.excerpt: The Celestine Suite, named after the wife of Café Royal's founder Celestine Nichols

facts.text: The Celestine Suite is one of Café Royal's original spaces, meticulously restored with golden gilding details.
facts.excerpt: this suite is one of the original spaces of Café Royal that has been meticulously restored, featuring golden gilding details

facts.text: The Club Suite combines Café Royal's French heritage with contemporary design, with original red and gold gildings in the living room.
facts.excerpt: The living room is bathed in original rich red and gold gildings, and restored mirrors are complemented by a golden Sienna marble dining table

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Tudor Suite is a historic suite that evokes the Elizabethan era.
facts.excerpt: this one-of-a-kind historic suite transports you back to the Elizabethan era

facts.text: Westminster Suites have views of London landmarks such as Piccadilly Circus, Westminster, St James and Regent Street.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy breathtaking views of London landmarks such as Piccadilly Circus, Westminster, St James, and Regent Street.

facts.text: Suite guests booked in a Deluxe Suite or higher get a chauffeur for up to 5 hours a day between arrival and departure.
facts.excerpt: On the days in between, your chauffeur is available for up to 5 hours each day.

facts.text: Royal Suite and Dome Penthouse guests can use a Rolls Royce.
facts.excerpt: Those in our Royal Suite or Dome Penthouse can indulge in the luxury of a Rolls Royce.

facts.text: Suite stays include a Laundered Luggage Service, cleaning suitcases to standards set by TUMI.
facts.excerpt: transporting your suitcase (of any brand) for laundering, following the standards set by TUMI

facts.text: Deluxe suites and higher categories get seasonal floral arrangements by florist Jamie Aston.
facts.excerpt: handcraft seasonal floral arrangements to adorn our Deluxe suites and higher categories

facts.text: Suite inclusions are available when booking direct.
facts.excerpt: Suite inclusions are available when booking direct.

facts.text: Rates are subject to a 5% discretionary service charge.
facts.excerpt: Rates are subject to 5% discretionary service charge

facts.text: The hotel offers family stays in the West End, near museums and shows.
facts.excerpt: Base yourselves in the vibrant heart of the West End where unforgettable moments begin.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the only place in London to convene, converse and celebrate.
facts.excerpt: The only place in London to convene, converse, and celebrate.
